reviews.comment:
Una lástima cada vez que quiero cargar combustible tengo que esperar de madia hora a 45 minutos ocuando se dignen de charlar esto ocurre todos los días de 0630 a 0725 opte para no esperar tanto y perder los puntos de cruzarme a shell de Figueroa alcorta pago un poco más pero la atención lo vale una lastima que siendo socio tenga que ir a otro lado ponganse las pilas y cuiden al cliente es  de no recomendar en esa fraja horaria

(Translated by Google)
It's a shame that every time I want to fill up I have to wait half an hour to 45 minutes, or whenever they deign to talk to me. This happens every day from 6:30 to 7:25. To avoid waiting so long and losing points, I opted to go to the Shell station on Figueroa Alcorta. I pay a little more, but the service is worth it. It's a shame that as a member I have to go somewhere else. Get your act together and take care of your customers. I wouldn't recommend going there during those hours.
